summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing daily purchases under its buy-back programme announced 28 October 2026, executed through Goldman Sachs International as agent. On 30 October 2026 the company bought 170,000 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of 12.7644 (range 12.6920-12.8900) and 599,600 shares in Hong Kong at a VWAP of HK$136.0227 (range HK$135.1000-136.6000). Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 1,537,600 shares for approximately US$26.6m; shares are cancelled, leaving issued ordinary share capital of 17,134,683,491 with no treasury shares. Routine programme execution rather than a discrete special event; Hong Kong cancellations lag UK settlements, so watch cumulative buy-back pace and any total voting rights updates.
